description: This file defines the CodeIndexManager class, which manages code indexing services, including initialization, starting/stopping indexing, error recovery, and configuration handling within a VSCode extension environment.

classes.name: CodeIndexManager
classes.description: Manages code indexing lifecycle, configuration, error recovery, and service orchestration within a VSCode extension.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a singleton instance of CodeIndexManager for a given workspace.

methods.name: disposeAll
methods.description: Disposes all existing CodeIndexManager instances.

methods.name: get onProgressUpdate
methods.description: Event emitter for progress updates.

methods.name: assertInitialized
methods.description: Ensures that the manager has been initialized before proceeding.

methods.name: get state
methods.description: Returns the current indexing state.

methods.name: isFeatureEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the code indexing feature is enabled.

methods.name: isFeatureConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the feature is properly configured.

methods.name: isInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the manager has been initialized.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the manager with configuration and services, possibly requiring a restart.

methods.name: startIndexing
methods.description: Starts the indexing process asynchronously, recovering from errors if needed.

methods.name: stopWatcher
methods.description: Stops the file watcher.

methods.name: cancelIndexing
methods.description: Immediately cancels ongoing indexing activities.

methods.name: updateBatchSegmentThreshold
methods.description: Updates the batch segment threshold for indexing.

methods.name: recoverFromError
methods.description: Resets internal state and services after an error to allow re-initialization.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and disposes the manager.

methods.name: clearIndexData
methods.description: Clears all index data, including cache and collection.

methods.name: clearErrorState
methods.description: Resets the system state to standby, clearing error states.

methods.name: getCurrentStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status including workspace path.

methods.name: searchIndex
methods.description: Performs a search on the index with a query and optional directory prefix.

methods.name: _recreateServices
methods.description: Recreates services based on current configuration, used during initialization and settings change.

methods.name: handleSettingsChange
methods.description: Handles updates to configuration settings, recreating services if needed.
